TRAVEL RETAIL INSIDER | Aug 20 2026

PRE-OWNED LUXURY MARKET TO REACH $58BN AS YOUNGER BUYERS TRADE UP

By TRI desk

The global pre-owned luxury market is set to grow 9 percent this year to about 58 billion dollars, according to a new industry report. Outerwear and sneakers are the fastest-growing categories after handbags and watches.

The report highlights Korea and China, where platforms such as KREAM and Xianyu have made reselling limited items mainstream. Prices for hyped new releases can exceed retail by 50 percent or more in the first weeks after launch.
